---
title: Data Cleaning
format: typst
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
svpre <- read.csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

svpre <- svpre |> #select the sv precinct cols of choice
  select(c("COUNTY", "FIPS", "SVPREC", "ADDIST", "SVPREC_KEY", "ELECTION", "GEO_TYPE", "CDDIST", "SDDIST", "BEDIST", "TOTREG", "TOTVOTE", "ASSDEM01", "ASSDEM02", "ASSREP01", "ASSREP02", "CNGDEM01", "CNGDEM02", "CNGREP01", "CNGREP02", "PRSDEM01", "PRSREP01")) |>
  filter(!str_detect(ASSDEM01, "[***]"))

results <- read_excel("data/g24-results-by-district.xlsx")

```

```{r}
write_csv(x = svpre, file = "data/svpre.csv")
```
